verdict.rationale: Stagehand is an SDK whose public programmatic API is documented in depth. The docs cover `act()`, `extract()`, `observe()` and `agent`, page methods, browser configuration and reference pages, across TypeScript, Python and Go, so a user or agent can drive it entirely through code. Community users confirm it works as a programmatic abstraction, and it also exposes MCP tools and publishes llms.txt. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/HTTP spec (all probed OpenAPI paths return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: extract() grabs structured data from a webpage. Every call takes an instruction and an output shape
observe() discovers actionable elements on a page and returns structured actions you can execute or validate before acting.
Use familiar APIs, self-healing actions, and network-level security across TypeScript, Python, and Go.
`agent` turns high level tasks into **fully autonomous** browser workflows.
